grammarFocus: was / were；常用过去式入门；be going to；because；基础句型综合复习。
title: Tom's Busy Saturday
instructions: 阅读短文，回答8个问题。题目为模拟练习，不是官方考试。请根据短文内容选择或填写答案。
passage: Tom is a student. He was busy last Saturday. He was at home in the morning. He was hungry, so he ate a sandwich. Then he was tired, so he slept for one hour. In the afternoon, he was at the park. He was happy because the weather was nice. He played football with his friend. Now Tom is at home. He is going to visit his grandmother tomorrow. He is going to take a bus. He is going to bring some fruit. He is going to stay for two hours. He is going to go home at six o'clock.

questions.prompt: Tom 上周六上午在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文说 'He was at home in the morning.'，所以选 At home。
questions.evidence: He was at home in the morning.

questions.prompt: Tom 为什么吃了一个三明治？
questions.explanation: 短文说 'He was hungry, so he ate a sandwich.'，意思是他饿了，所以吃三明治。选项 Because he was hungry 意思相同。
questions.evidence: He was hungry, so he ate a sandwich.

questions.explanation: 短文说 'In the afternoon, he was at the park.'，所以选 At the park。
questions.evidence: In the afternoon, he was at the park.

questions.explanation: 短文说 'He was happy because the weather was nice.'，所以选 Because the weather was nice。
questions.evidence: He was happy because the weather was nice.

questions.explanation: 短文说 'He played football with his friend.'，所以选 His friend。
questions.evidence: He played football with his friend.

questions.explanation: 短文说 'He is going to visit his grandmother tomorrow.'，所以选 Visit his grandmother。
questions.evidence: He is going to visit his grandmother tomorrow.

questions.prompt: Tom 打算怎么去？他打算乘 ______。请用短文中的一个词填空。
questions.explanation: 短文说 'He is going to take a bus.'，所以填 bus。
questions.evidence: He is going to take a bus.

questions.prompt: Tom 打算待多久？他打算待 ______ 小时。请用短文中的一个词填空。
questions.explanation: 短文说 'He is going to stay for two hours.'，所以填 two。
questions.evidence: He is going to stay for two hours.

vocabulary.example: He was hungry, so he ate a sandwich.
Then he was tired, so he slept for one hour.
In the afternoon, he was at the park.

He is going to visit his grandmother tomorrow.

He is going to stay for two hours.

grammar.title: 过去时 was/were 与 be going to
grammar.explanation: 我们用 was 或 were 表示过去的状态。I/he/she/it 用 was，you/we/they 用 were。例如：He was at home. 我们用 be going to 表示计划。例如：He is going to visit his grandmother.
grammar.example: He was at home in the morning. He is going to visit his grandmother tomorrow.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：Tom ______ at the park yesterday.
questions.explanation: Tom 是第三人称单数，过去时用 was。
questions.evidence: In the afternoon, he was at the park.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：They ______ happy last night.
questions.explanation: They 是复数，过去时用 were。
questions.evidence: He was happy because the weather was nice.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：She ______ going to cook dinner tomorrow.
questions.explanation: be going to 表示计划，She 是第三人称单数，用 is。
questions.evidence: He is going to visit his grandmother tomorrow.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：I ______ going to read a book tonight.
questions.evidence: He is going to visit his grandmother tomorrow.

speaking.part2: Describe a plan you have for next week. You should say: what you are going to do; where you are going to go; who you are going to go with; and explain why you are going to do this.

transfer.writing: 写一篇短文，介绍你上周六做了什么以及你明天的计划。用上 was/were 和 be going to。写 5-8 句话。
